name: Worldforged Ring of the Sunken Courier rests reachable in the Hinterlands (#9601)
contract: #9601 reported the pickup (gameobject entry 95903, guid 6940968, item 515710) as underground, ~21 yd below the reporter's own standing position in the Hinterlands. Measured against the map/vmap, the spawn sits 0.38 yd below its ground probe (well inside the normal grounded tolerance), has an obstruction-free clearance and headroom, carries a client-visible display, and opens and grants its item like any other reachable worldforged pickup. This scenario is evidence that guid 6940968 needs no coordinate correction.
